content: It'ee Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa neerahaazhii diits'an hahtsyaa nyąą ąįį gwik'it t'ihee'yaa t'inyąą. Ąįįts'ą' datthak adak'aroonti', diitee ch'ihłak gaa zhat gwahah'yaa kwaa gweheelyaa geenjit.
Diikhwan t'ee ąįį Gwandak Nizįį giitth'ak gwik'it tr'iitth'ak. Gwandak Nizįį giitth'ak gaa nik'it goovaa gwiizųų, nijin ąįį ginjik giitth'ak dąį', gwik'injigwiighit haa gwagoonjii kwaa geh'an.
Diikhwan gwik'injiriighit nąįį nijin neerahaazhii Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa diinantł'eegwehee'aa. Jii jyaa digweheenjyaa nyąą ąįį gwik'it goodlit,

content.text: “Shik'įį gwanlii ts'ą' jii łi'deegwidlii haa gwik'it gweheelyaa kwaa, dihnyą',
‘Nijin nankat neegahaazhii gooveenjit goołtsąįį chy'ah, aiizhit gwizhit nihdeegiheedaa kwaa!’”

content: Nijin nan iłtsąįį dąį' digwitr'it gęhdaa tr'iinjik googaa nihk'it jyaa diinyą'.
Dęhtły'aa Choh zhit gwa'an Neegwaazhii Drin jii t'ee jyaa digwinyąą, “Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa drin 7 nigwiindhat gwizhit digwitr'it datthak gwats'an naazhii.”
Dęhtły'aa Choh zhit gwa'an chan jyaa digwinyąą, “Duuyeh gwik'it nijin nan ąįį goovantł'eiin'ąįį chy'aa ąįį gwizhit neegahaazhii geenjit nihdeegijyaa.”

Zhit Israel nąįį tr'ookit Gwandak Nizįį diitth'ak nąįį neegahaazhii geenjit goovantł'eegwariin'ąįį gaa gwik'it t'igiizhit kwaa, gwik'injigiighit kwaa geh'an. Gaa juk ch'izhii nąįį antł'eegwiriin'ąįį, geedan gogohoondal geenjit.

Jii t'ee łi'deegwidlii gwanlii ts'ą' gwizhrįh gwigweech'in goodlit, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ch'izhii drin neerahahshii nineegwin'ąįį, ts'ą', “Juk drin” goozhii, niighyuk gwahaadhat tł'ęę gǫhju' hee King David geeginkhe' gwiłtsąįį ąįįts'ą' Dęhtły'aa Choh zhit gwadanakhwatł'oo,
Joshua, Israel nąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa neegahaazhii goovantł'eiin'ąįį gwik'it t'iizhik ji', Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa duuyeh ch'izhii drin gęhdaa gwandaa geeginkhii t'oonchy'aa.
Ąįįts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vigii nąįį eenjit tth'aii hee neerahaazhii goo'aii, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa drin 7 gwizhit naazhii ąįį gwik'it t'igwehee'yaa.
Ąįį juu neegahaazhii goots'an dhidlit nąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa deehee'yaa nyąą gwik'it t'ihee'yaa geenjit digwigwitr'it ts'an neegahaazhii, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa digwitr'it gwats'an naazhii gwik'it.

Ąįįts'ą', ąįį neerahaazhii tr'ooheendal geenjit gwint'aii gwitr'it t'agwaroh'ya', nangwinjir gwa'an Israel nąįį deegiizhik gwik'it diitee ch'ihłee gaa gwik'injigwiighit gii'įį kwaa geh'an neegahaazhii nihdeegiheedaa kwaa.

Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik ąįįt'ee gwandaii nilii ts'ą' k'eegwiichy'aa datthak yaa t'ii'in shrii choh veek'i' neekwaii gwanlii jiinin k'it t'inchy'aa. Ąįį nijin diizhin ts'ą' diinanky'aa haa nihłaa t'inchy'aa, ąįį zhit gwats'an nijin ch'izhee ts'ą' diitth'an haa nihłoon'ee ąįį zhit gwats'ą' datthak gwit'ii k'it t'oonchy'aa. Jyąhts'ą' gwik'iighai' nats'ahts'ą' diidrii zhit ninjich'aradhat ts'ą' gwiizųų akwat gwinzii ąįį geenjit deegwiindhan ąįį kwaii datthak gaandaii geenjit diinoohahkat t'inchy'aa.
Jidii gwiłtsąįį datthak vaa gwizhrįh nagwaanąįį ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vandee ts'ą' goodlii ts'ą' adan t'ee dzaa nankat deegwee'ya' vagwarahaandak t'inchy'aa.
Jesus, Ndak Khii Giinkhih Choh Nilii

Ąįįts'ą' ndak khii giinkhih choh tr'ii'įį, ąįį nijin Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa t'inchy'aa gwats'ą' haazhii geh'an jii gwik'injigwiighit eegwaraandak ąįį gwint'aii tr'oontą'. Ąįįt'ee Jesus Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vidinji' t'inchy'aa.

Ndak khii diigiinkhii choh, diit'aii kwaa gaandaii geenjit neeshraahchy'aa diinoonyąą ts'ą', adan gaa tr'agwaanduu t'ihee'yaa geenjit nihłehjuk datthak vik'eegaroonjik gaa nihk'it tr'agwaanduu t'ee'ya' kwaa.

Ąįįts'ą' tr'aanjat kwaa haa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ch'eiinzhrii k'eegwaadhat ts'ą' yakat doodii vats'a' tr'iheedaa, izhit ch'eegoonzhrįį ts'ą' neeshraahchy'aa diinahoonjyaa haa nijin gwit'eegwaahchy'aa dąį' diits'iheenjyaa.
